overall: The AG found the Commission did not violate the Open Meeting Law by discussing 47 Rockland Road without it on the notice, because the topic was credibly unanticipated 48 hours before the meeting; the further-review complaint about detail was declined.

allegations.summary: Commission discussed a property (47 Rockland Road) at its August 13 meeting without listing it on the posted notice.
In a request for further review, complainant alleged the Commission did not discuss his open meeting law complaint in enough detail.
allegations.key_passage: To the extent that Mr. Rafferty makes additional allegations in his request for further review, including that the Commission did not discuss his open meeting law complaint in enough detail, we decline to review these allegations.

allegations.summary: Commission argued the update was not deliberation because only one member spoke, so it needed no notice; raised as a defense.
allegations.key_passage: Because we find that the topic was unanticipated, we need not address this argument.
